on-accent.note: Black or white per theme for 4.5:1 on a solid accent fill.

bottombar.source: --sb-layer-bottombar (dark: same as Canvas; light: BlurTint 95% + Body 5%)

shadow-ink.note: Shade and shadow tint only; never a text colour.

display.purpose: Home and first-run welcome titles only.

headline.purpose: Opened shell and major panel headings.

title.purpose: Setting groups, action rows, cards, and compact headings.

body.purpose: Chat and settings prose. Line height 1.55 instead of 1.4 for long-form reading.

label.libadwaita: .caption-heading (0.82 in libadwaita; kept at 0.72 to avoid overflow in tight shell layouts)
label.purpose: Compact metadata and state labels in sentence case.

mono.purpose: Logs, regex, prompt fragments, token diagnostics, and structured output.

shadows.name: headerbar-shade
shadows.purpose: Bottom line of the top bar and top line of the composer. No blurred shadow.

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: Menus, select dropdowns, search results, persona picker, message popovers. Paired with one 1px border.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Dialogs and shell drawers. Paired with one 1px border.

shadows.name: dialog-backdrop
shadows.value: shade colour at about 50% (dark) or 14% (light); no blur

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Single focus-visible treatment for buttons, tabs, and menu rows; never stacked with an outline or outer ring. Fields draw the same colour as their border plus a 1px inset (--sb-entry-focus-border, --sb-entry-focus-ring), which reads as the same 2px ring. About 55% accent, slightly above libadwaita 50% for 3:1 in both tones.

shadows.name: focus-outline-small
shadows.purpose: Focus-visible for checkboxes and radios; ranges use a 4px offset.

flatFills.name: flat-hover
flatFills.purpose: Flat button hover, gated behind (hover: hover).

flatFills.name: flat-selected
flatFills.purpose: Selected tab, nav item, or toggled toolbar button.

flatFills.name: raised
flatFills.purpose: Raised circular controls such as shell close and mobile back.

flatFills.name: raised-active
flatFills.purpose: Raised control pressed or expanded (libadwaita uses 30%).

rowPrimitives.name: row
rowPrimitives.value: min-height 44px (52px with subtitle); padding 6px 16px; 1px bottom separator, none on the last row of a group
rowPrimitives.purpose: Base settings row: .ds-row-text on the start side, .ds-row-suffix on the end side.

rowPrimitives.name: row-subtitle
rowPrimitives.purpose: Visible description promoted verbatim from title= text; lorum ipsum until final copy.

rowPrimitives.name: row-suffix
rowPrimitives.purpose: Trailing control: select, input, switch, button.

rowPrimitives.name: row-switch
rowPrimitives.value: whole-row label; native checkbox carries role=switch and its checked state; no aria-checked (ARIA in HTML forbids it on input type=checkbox)

rowPrimitives.name: row-entry-floating
rowPrimitives.value: linked single-line title inside a filled input; --sb-composer-input-bg, transparent 1px border, --sb-radius-button, min-height max(48px, 3.4em); focus ring on the input, suffix outside
rowPrimitives.purpose: Connections single-line entries. Float on focus, value or autofill; placeholder text appears only on focus. Adopt the input without changing its type.

rowPrimitives.name: row-entry-secret
rowPrimitives.value: placeholder MutationObserver supplies saved/missing icon and visually hidden aria-describedby text; unknown status hidden; -webkit-text-security: disc and Reveal only where supported
rowPrimitives.purpose: API keys without changing the upstream text input type or invoking password-manager behaviour. Deviation: entry, reveal and key management may exceed two controls.

rowPrimitives.name: row-entry-caption
rowPrimitives.value: dimmed caption below the field, linked by aria-describedby; multi-line instructions remain above; preserve help nodes and gated warnings
rowPrimitives.purpose: Deviation: AdwEntryRow has no subtitle; the floating factory uses its subtitle option as the caption to retain upstream help.

rowPrimitives.name: row-toggle
rowPrimitives.value: named radiogroup of label-only native radio segments; neutral selected fill; fill stacks the title over equal-width wrapping segments; 44px segments on coarse pointers
rowPrimitives.purpose: Exclusive settings such as Backend Type or Parallel/Sequential, not view switching.

rowPrimitives.name: row-select
rowPrimitives.value: hidden adopted native select and adjacent hidden select2 container; trigger shows selected text; whole-row hover, active and inset focus; shared chevron edge
rowPrimitives.purpose: Shared searchable picker mirrors optgroups, disabled options, multiple selection and late loads. Native bubbling change writes back; jQuery change listening follows upstream writes. Ordered multi-selects append new picks. Second trigger/background click closes; opening a competitor closes the current popup.

rowPrimitives.name: row-profile
rowPrimitives.value: select-mirror row with optional summary and suffix spinner; trailing vertical ellipsis only when onMenu exists
rowPrimitives.purpose: Connections and per-agent profiles keep the menu; Default and Companion profiles in Agents Settings omit it. Folders/favourites follow the native optgroups; actions use existing handlers.

rowPrimitives.name: row-slider
rowPrimitives.value: range plus 5.5em number field; stacks at 620px and below

rowPrimitives.name: row-expander
rowPrimitives.value: details > summary.ds-row + .ds-row-expander-content; trailing chevron points down when collapsed and up when expanded
rowPrimitives.purpose: Multi-control samplers and other grouped options.

rowPrimitives.name: control-flex
rowPrimitives.purpose: Stable control width regardless of the label length. widthNatural and widthUnset controls keep their natural width.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Hover, press, focus, selection, colour and fill changes.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Reveals, expanders, height changes, banners, crossfades.

motion.name: spring-dialog
motion.purpose: Dialog open: scale 0.8 to 1 and fade from centre. The only overshoot.

motion.name: spring-sheet
motion.purpose: Shell drawers and mobile sheets: fade and scale 0.96 to 1 from the trigger.

motion.name: popover
motion.value: 200ms fade + scale 0.96 to 1 from the trigger edge; 150ms fade out
motion.purpose: Options, extensions, select dropdowns, search results, context menus. GTK4 popovers do not animate; this is a deliberate origin cue.

motion.name: toast
motion.value: 300ms slide from own height + fade in; 300ms fade + scale to 0.95 out

motion.name: spring-fallback
motion.value: cubic-bezier fallback where CSS linear() is unsupported (Safari < 17.2)
motion.purpose: Springs are sampled into linear() easings.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: no movement or scale; instant or a crossfade of 200ms or less
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion or the Reduced Motion setting. JS helpers are no-ops.

breakpoints.name: compact-desktop
breakpoints.purpose: Compact desktop contract; fork mobile chrome does not start yet.

breakpoints.name: hig-phone-minimum
breakpoints.purpose: Smallest size every layout must support (HIG Scaling & Adaptiveness).

breakpoints.name: hig-desktop-minimum
breakpoints.purpose: Smallest supported desktop size in the HIG.

radii.name: control
radii.purpose: Menu rows, search result rows, tooltips, and new non-pill shell controls.

radii.name: card
radii.purpose: Target for content cards when pages are migrated.

radii.name: overlay
radii.purpose: Popovers, menus, dialogs, shell drawers, toasts, and the composer stack.

radii.name: legacy-content
radii.purpose: Existing page content until each page is migrated.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: libadwaita suggested action: the single primary confirmation or launch action in a view. A view has at most one suggested or destructive button. Label is an imperative verb in header capitalisation. No hover lift.

The dimmed heading icon is a SillyBunny addition; libadwaita group titles have none.

components.description: Stable search, prompt, settings, and compact form field. Focus draws the accent focus-ring colour on the border plus a 1px inset, as libadwaita entries do. The label uses header capitalisation; the placeholder uses sentence capitalisation.

components.name: Floating Entry Row
components.description: createEntryRow({ floating: true }) adopts the live single-line input. A linked, ellipsised title floats on focus, value/programmatic writes and autofill; its full title remains the accessible name. Filled shell text-entry styling, with focus on the input and suffix outside. The subtitle option is a help caption (AdwEntryRow deviation). The secret object mirrors placeholder status as an icon plus described text; masking and Reveal exist only where -webkit-text-security is supported, never by changing input type. Characters, Persona, World Info and Agents retain stacked entries until migrated.

components.name: Toggle Row
components.description: createToggleRow wraps two or more label-only native radio segments in a named radiogroup. Neutral selected fill, arrow-key grouping, no icons or tab semantics. fill puts the title above equal-width wrapping segments; preserve wording down to 360px and use 44px segments on coarse pointers.

components.name: Select Mirror Row
components.description: createSelectRow adopts the hidden native select as source of truth, with select2 initialised and its container adjacent but hidden. A named trigger shows the current value and opens the shared searchable picker; optgroups, disabled options, multiple selection and late loads are mirrored. Native bubbling change writes back, jQuery change listening follows external updates, and ordered multi-selects append new picks. The row owns hover/active/focus, not the transparent trigger. Second click closes; only one menu, picker or popover at a time.

components.name: Profile Row
components.description: createProfileRow specialises the select-mirror row for profiles: folders/favourites from native optgroups, optional summary subtitle and application spinner. The trailing vertical ellipsis exists only when onMenu is supplied: present in Connections and the agent editor, absent on the two Agents Settings profile rows. Actions forward to existing handlers. The picker and menu obey second-click dismissal and one-popup-at-a-time rules.

components.name: Agent Row
components.description: Leading grip and dimmed category icon, name/one-line description, optional update note, plain dimmed token count, trailing enable switch and menu. Deviation: three controls total, as on prompt rows, not three trailing controls. Move Up/Down shares drag order within the stage/category sub-heading; omit at boundaries, under any search/filter and on Pinned copies, retaining alignment slots and moved-row focus. Deviation: up to 13 menu items; organise/run/manage/destructive sections, explicit command icons (never fallback), with Restore Default and Delete last in danger ink and always confirmed (Cancel focused, no destructive Return default). Delete is present even on the only bundled copy. Beside an open detail pane hide subtitle and row menu and keep the 52px minimum, following Prompt; badge slot hides at ≤400px except beside an agent editor, with tokens still described accessibly.

components.name: Connections Panel
components.description: Connection Profile, Backend, active provider Connection/Model/Providers/Advanced, General; empty provider groups hide and unknown fields remain in Advanced. No sticky elements; same controls down to 360px. Group headers match Customize with bold body title, bold muted meta subtitle, 2px title gap and 8px to the box. No invented status subtitle; model/server stays in upstream text. Phones centre status and stack actions. Authorize remains a gated button row, Featherless a restyled widget; preserve IDs, handlers and visibility gates. Floating entries and help captions follow their shared contracts.

components.name: Agents List
components.description: Saved agents only. Pinned then Before Reply, Before and After Reply, After Reply and Companions use strong headers, with plain category sub-headings and no list subcategories. components.name: Agent Editor Property Bar
components.description: Under the editable-title header: Category listbox, Stage (Before/After/Both), Execution (Inline/Companion) and Pin. components.name: List → Split Editor
components.description: SillyBunny-specific pattern built from Libadwaita parts; AdwNavigationSplitView collapse rules. Libadwaita sidebars are not user-resizable and no stock widget animates from a full-width list into a split view. Resizable sidebar 240–420px, default 30%; collapse at viewport ≤768px or Editor pane <720px. Collapsed navigation: the editor is a full-screen page with a back button; no sidebar. Text-first Prompt editors keep the pane non-scrolling and let textareas fill remaining height and scroll internally. Multi-group Characters, Agents, Persona and World Info scroll one body, not the shell/detail frame; main text areas have a minimum height and Expand. At ≤768px, Agents prompt minimum is clamp(320px, min(45dvh, measured shell viewport × 0.45), 560px), other editor/helper text areas clamp(180px, min(30dvh, measured shell viewport × 0.3), 360px), with vh fallbacks and keyboard visibility handling. These minimums are not fixed heights or a rule for Prompt. Full list → list shrinks to a sidebar while the editor slides in from the right; reverse on close. SPRING_NAVIGATION (334ms), continuous compression. Clicking another row in the sidebar swaps editor content without replaying the slide, after the dirty check. Reduced motion: instant swap for OS prefers-reduced-motion or body.reduced-motion.

narrative.northStar: Simple by default, powerful when needed
narrative.overview:
SillyBunny is an LLM roleplay client that best embodies KDE Plasma's driving philosophy alongside the HIG (human interface guidelines) of the GNOME project. Although great inspiration is taken from these projects, SillyBunny still stands on its own with a slight sense of whimsy based on its focus on roleplay and storywriting. The shell is deliberately kept out of the way so the user can focus on the main content until configuration and navigation are needed.

Helpful wording, tactile and easily glanceable feedback, and deliberate purpose define the shell. Complex configuration remains available to the user if they wish to seek it (as per upstream SillyTavern), but a good default experience is mandatory and implied. Configuration remains behind the shell at all times until called for. All elements of the shell must remain themeable with user CSS themes, and be fully compatible with SillyTavern data, presets, extensions, and settings.

The design philosophies of the GNOME project and its HIG should always be taken into consideration. This means accessibility through lack of distractions, animations that guide the user to what is clicked/tapped, responsive layouts, predictable touch targets, and nothing getting in the way of the main user experience. Mobile design must remain purposefully designed alongside the desktop, adapting libadwaita to a smaller and more touch-heavy window.

With this in mind, SillyBunny can inject its own fun in the design too. After all, it is a roleplay and storywriting client at heart. Included tutorial characters are helpful yet creatively fun to interact with.

This system rejects UI creep, nested menu spirals, configuration sprawl, bottom bar bloat, mystery meat navigation, desktop-only assumptions, and generic SaaS polish.
keyCharacteristics: Content-first chat viewport with no unsolicited permanent configuration panels.
Familiar controls that disclose depth through deliberate input, not visual noise.
Guided animations that promote accessibility and intuitive motion.
Stable desktop and mobile interaction vocabulary, including WebKit-safe shell behavior.
Personality expressed through usefulness and built-in assistants and characters.

rules.name: The Signal Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Accent appears for action, selection, focus, or meaningful state. If removing it does not reduce comprehension, remove it.

rules.name: The Theme Alias Rule
rules.body: New work consumes `SmartTheme*`, `color-*`, `sb-*`, spacing, and radius aliases. Do not hard-code a new color that bypasses saved user themes.

rules.name: The Contrast Rule
rules.body: Body and placeholder text target at least 4.5:1 contrast; large text targets at least 3:1. Muted text can be quiet, but never illegible. Colour is never the only carrier of information; pair it with text, an icon, or shape (HIG UI Styling). Surfaces stay usable under `prefers-contrast: more` and `forced-colors: active`.

rules.name: The Opaque Shell Rule
rules.body: Header bars, drawers, popovers, menus, dialogs, and toasts are opaque. No `backdrop-filter` on shell layers; background images may show only through the canvas and the chat column at the theme's own tint alpha.

rules.name: The Single Shell Rule
rules.body: The shell has one libadwaita direction; there is no Shell Style picker, and stored legacy `sb-theme` values are ignored. UI themes, custom CSS, and the accent colour are the theming surface.

rules.name: The Interface Sans Rule
rules.body: Use the interface stack (Adwaita Sans, then system fallbacks) for controls, tabs, labels, and dense settings. Decorative type must never make repeated work harder.

rules.name: The User Scale Rule
rules.body: Product type follows `--mainFontSize` and existing user preferences. Do not add viewport-driven type or a parallel density system.

rules.name: The Wrap Safety Rule
rules.body: Headings use balanced wrapping where supported, and all labels must tolerate long translations, zoom, and narrow mobile widths without overflow.

rules.name: The Capitalisation Rule
rules.body: Follow the HIG Writing Style. Header capitalisation for headings (group, list, page, sheet, and dialog titles), header bar and view titles, view switcher and tab labels, button labels, menu items, tooltips, field labels, and boxed-list row titles; capitalise the first and last word, nouns, verbs, hyphenated words, and every word of four or more letters. Sentence capitalisation for checkbox and radio labels, drop-down items, placeholders, row subtitles, captions, and body text. Headings omit articles and auxiliary verbs. Never all caps or uppercase tracked kickers. Group headings are bold; their dimmed leading icon is a SillyBunny addition. Every field label and boxed-list row title uses header capitalisation, resolving the HIG's mixed guidance on field and drop-down labels. Upstream SillyTavern strings keep their wording and data-i18n keys; existing sentence-case labels move to this rule as each surface is reworked.

rules.name: The Layer Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Establish a tonal surface before adding elevation. If a shadow is doing all the work, the surface token is wrong.

rules.name: The Flat Toolbar Rule
rules.body: Toolbar and navigation buttons are transparent at rest. Hover, press, and selection use neutral fills mixed from the body color, with no borders, bottom stripes, underlines, glows, or hover lift. Hover fills apply only under `(hover: hover)`.

rules.name: The Reduced Motion Rule
rules.body: `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` or the Reduced Motion setting removes movement and scale. State changes become instant or a crossfade of 200ms or less. JS helpers are no-ops under reduced motion.

rules.name: The WebKit Reliability Rule
rules.body: Prefer solid surfaces on mobile. Fixed layers must respect safe areas, keyboard resizing, scrolling, and focus behavior in Safari/WebKit.

rules.name: The State-Only Motion Rule
rules.body: Animate state, origin, and destination only. No decorative choreography, ambient loops, or hover lift. Only the dialog spring overshoots.

dos: Do keep main content uninterrupted and let configuration appear only after deliberate input.
Do give every view at most one suggested or destructive button, then place powerful options behind learnable progressive disclosure.
Do preserve SillyTavern-compatible settings, character data, chats, presets, extensions, and migration paths.
Do use `SmartTheme*`, `sb-*`, `color-*`, spacing, and radius tokens so user themes continue to work.
Do keep desktop and mobile gestures, ordering, labels, and action vocabulary consistent.
Do provide visible focus, semantic labels, comfortable touch targets, resilient wrapping, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do use tonal surfaces before shadows and verify text contrast before shipping.

Do make every action possible with the keyboard as well as with a pointer or touch. Custom shortcuts use Ctrl with a letter, never Alt (reserved for access keys) or Super. Esc closes popovers, sheets, and dialogs (HIG Keyboard, Popovers, Windows).

Do test every surface with a high-contrast or forced-colours mode, 200% text size, the keyboard alone, a screen reader, and an on-screen keyboard (HIG Accessibility). Every element has a short, descriptive accessible name.

Do write UI text by the HIG Writing Style: short and neutral, familiar terms over system terms, "your" over "my" when ownership must be stated, no Latin abbreviations, and no trailing period on labels, headings, or descriptions. An ellipsis (…, U+2026) ends a label only when more input or confirmation follows. Never build one sentence from several strings or controls. Use typographic characters: “quotes”, ’ apostrophes, – ranges, × dimensions.

Do translate each new counter or sentence as one string with placeholders, never joined fragments. Use … rather than three periods in new labels. Reuse existing upstream strings and keys verbatim, including trailing periods; the punctuation rule applies to new copy. Unsupplied descriptions, help and dialog bodies use exactly lorum ipsum, marked with data-sb-copy-placeholder="true" and reported for maintainer replacement; do not draft project prose.
donts: Don't add configuration panels, extra toolbars, or utility panes to the chat viewport unless the user opens them. Navigation sidebars, split views, and utility panes follow the HIG (Navigation): each view keeps one clear subject, and panes collapse or overlay at narrow widths.
Don't create a nested menu spiral: no nested submenus, and hierarchies generally one level deep below a view (HIG Menus, Navigation).
Don't present configuration sprawl, bottom bar bloat, or a dense control wall by default.
Don't interrupt active conversation with a modal for non-critical configuration; try inline or progressive alternatives first.
Don't rely on mystery meat navigation, hover-only discovery, desktop-only assumptions, tiny touch targets, or fragile iOS WebKit behavior.
Don't use generic SaaS polish, sterile upstream-clone blandness, or decorative motion without navigational purpose.
Don't use gradient text, decorative glassmorphism, backdrop blur on shell layers, ambient accent glows, repeating stripe or grid backgrounds, identical repeated card grids, or sketchy illustrations.
Don't use `border-left` or `border-right` greater than `1px` as a colored accent.
Don't pair a `1px` border with a shadow of `16px` blur or more on a resting surface. Overlays may keep one border and one overlay shadow.
Don't use uppercase tracked kickers for group or list headings, or hover lift on buttons.
Don't rely on tooltips, hover, or colour alone to carry essential information.
Don't use radii above `20px` for cards or sections, or let long labels and headings overflow narrow viewports.
Don't introduce new pure black or pure white surfaces, or silently overwrite compatible user configuration.
narrative.referenceVersion: libadwaita 1.7+ (values checked against the 1.10.0 stylesheet); GNOME HIG pages checked 2026-10-19. Deviations are stated next to each value.

narrative.deviationPolicy: SillyBunny follows the GNOME HIG unless a rule says otherwise. Every departure is marked as a deviation next to the rule it affects in DESIGN.md.
